# React to Angular Skill

Use this skill when the user gives React code or React UI behavior to reproduce in Angular.

## Translation map
- props to typed Angular inputs
- callback props to outputs
- local state to Signals or component properties
- effects to Angular lifecycle or reactive composition
- memoized values to computed signals

## Preserve
- visual hierarchy
- interaction model
- validation logic
- accessibility
- loading states

## Rule
Do not replicate React patterns blindly if Angular has a better native solution.
